Title: Modern Web Chess Application MVP
Description: Deliver a full-featured, zero-install, responsive web chess application adhering strictly to international FIDE tournament rules and Chess.com standards.
Acceptance Criteria: 100% of FIDE rules verified via automated test suite. Sub-second initial load with responsive mobile/desktop viewports. AI runs off-thread maintaining 60 FPS.

Title: FIDE Rule Engine & Core State
Description: Core board state validation using chess.js, turn management, and FIDE special moves.
Acceptance Criteria: Legal move validation, special moves (castling, en passant, promotion), and draw/checkmate detection.

Title: Chess.com-Style Board UI & Procedural Audio
Description: Responsive Staunton SVG pieces, board color themes, move highlights, and Web Audio API synthesizer.
Acceptance Criteria: Drag & Drop and Click-to-Move, source/destination highlights, king check pulse, and zero-asset procedural sounds.

Title: Multi-Tier Web Worker AI Opponent
Description: Minimax search with Alpha-Beta pruning running in a background Web Worker.
Acceptance Criteria: Piece-Square tables (PST), 4 difficulty levels (Beginner to Master), non-blocking 60 FPS UI.

Title: Live Positional Evaluation Bar
Description: Continuous evaluation bar displaying real-time advantage beside the board.
Acceptance Criteria: Centipawn score display (+1.4, -0.8, +M), smooth visual height animation, and auto-flip support.

Title: Dual Chess Clocks & Time Controls
Description: Countdown chess timers with per-move increment support and timeout flag-fall detection.
Acceptance Criteria: Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, and Untimed presets; active clock highlighting; low-time alert.

Title: Move History & Position Navigation
Description: Algebraic move notation (SAN) list with interactive past-move replay and PGN/FEN export.
Acceptance Criteria: Two-column move list, click-to-replay past plies, and one-click clipboard copy for PGN and FEN.

Title: Game Customization & Position Loader
Description: Settings modal with board theme swatches and custom FEN string loader.
Acceptance Criteria: 5 themes (Classic Green, Wood, Slate, Midnight, Glass) and FEN position importer.

Title: Legal Piece Movement & Turns
Description: As a player, I want legal piece movement so that games adhere to official rules.
Acceptance Criteria: White moves first; pinned pieces cannot expose king; obstructed moves blocked.

Title: Special FIDE Moves (Castling & En Passant)
Description: As a competitive player, I want castling and en passant support.
Acceptance Criteria: Castling blocked through check; en passant allowed only on immediate turn.

Title: Interactive Pawn Promotion Modal
Description: As a player advancing a pawn to rank 8/1, I want a choice of Queen, Knight, Rook, or Bishop.
Acceptance Criteria: Modal displays immediately upon pawn reaching last rank; cancelable.

Title: Check
Acceptance Criteria: As a player, I want automatic game termination recognition citing official FIDE rules.

Title: Responsive Vector Board & Staunton Pieces
Description: As a user on mobile or desktop, I want sharp vector pieces and a scalable board.
Acceptance Criteria: Staunton SVG icons; 1:1 aspect ratio maintained.

Title: Dual Interaction (Drag & Drop + Click-to-Move)
Description: As a user, I want both drag-and-drop and click-to-move input.
Acceptance Criteria: Desktop mouse drag and mobile touch tap both execute moves.

Title: Move & Check Visual Highlights
Description: As a player, I want visual highlights for selected, last move, and check states.
Acceptance Criteria: Selected square (#f7f769), last move (#baca44), check (radial red pulse).

Title: Zero-Dependency Web Audio Effects
Description: As a player, I want tactile procedural audio for moves, captures, and checks.
Acceptance Criteria: Procedural Web Audio API sound synthesis; mute/unmute control.

Title: Minimax Search with Alpha-Beta Pruning
Description: As a solo player, I want an AI opponent that evaluates positions strategically.
Acceptance Criteria: Piece-Square tables (PST), MVV-LVA move ordering, alpha-beta pruning.

Title: AI Difficulty Profiles (Beginner to Master)
Description: As a player of any skill level, I want adjustable AI difficulty.
Acceptance Criteria: Beginner (~800), Intermediate (~1400), Advanced (~1800), Master (~2200).

Title: Non-Blocking Web Worker Threading
Description: As a player, I want 60 FPS smooth UI during AI calculation.
Acceptance Criteria: Web Worker runs search off main thread.

Title: Live Evaluation Bar Gauge
Description: As an analyzer, I want a real-time advantage bar next to the board.
Acceptance Criteria: Centipawn score display, sigmoid curve height, and auto-flip.

Title: Dual Digital Chess Clocks
Description: As a timed player, I want countdown clocks with increments.
Acceptance Criteria: Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, Untimed; increment addition; flag fall at 0:00.

Title: SAN Move History & Replay
Description: As a player reviewing a match, I want algebraic notation and move stepping.
Acceptance Criteria: SAN notation, step forward/backward buttons, jump to ply.

Title: PGN & FEN Clipboard Export
Description: As a player, I want to copy PGN and FEN strings to analyze elsewhere.
Acceptance Criteria: One-click copy to clipboard with toast confirmation.

Title: Board Theme Selection
Description: As a user, I want custom board color palettes.
Acceptance Criteria: 5 color themes with live preview swatches.

Title: Custom FEN Position Loader
Description: As a student, I want to load specific puzzle positions from FEN strings.
Acceptance Criteria: FEN string validation and instant board state initialization.
